Reports are emailed as PDF attachments to each project's distribution list when completed.
Requires the send-report-email Supabase Edge Function — see setup instructions below.

EDGE FUNCTION SETUP (ONE-TIME)
  1. Go to myaccount.google.com → Security → App Passwords → generate one
  2. In Supabase Dashboard → Edge Functions → New Function → name it send-report-email
  3. Paste the edge function code (from your administrator or deployment package)
  4. In Supabase → Settings → Edge Function Secrets, add:
    GMAIL_USER = your Gmail address
    GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD = the 16-char app password
  5. Enter your Gmail address above and click Save

Create custom team types beyond the built-in roles. Each team gets its own login tile and hub access.

HUB ACCESS FOR THIS TEAM

Restrict admins or Section Admins to specific hubs only. Leave all unchecked for full access.

Assign technicians to each approver. An approver will only see pending reports from their assigned team — keeps soil, concrete, and field approvals separate.
Leave all unchecked to allow an approver to see all pending reports.

DMF-68C — NUCLEAR DENSITY WORKSHEET

One-Point Proctor / Nuclear Gauge Field Calculation — linked to sample

DENSITY COUNT (3 Readings)
Reading WD DD (X) M % M(Y)
1
2
3
Total — — — —
Avg — — — —
CALCULATED VALUES
A Wet Dens. pcf — Average —
B Water pcf — Average %M(Y) —
C Dry Density Total Material (A−B %M avg) —
D Wt. of Sample + Container
E Wt. of Container (0 if negligible)
F Wt. of Sample (D−E) —
G Wet Wt. of +¾" Material
H % Moist. of +¾" (assume 1.5)
I Dry Wt. of +¾" [G/(100+H)×100] —
J Wet Wt. Minus ¾" Material (F−G) —
K % Moist. of Total Material = avg %M(Y) —
L Dry Wt. Total Minus ¾" [J/(100+K)×100] —
M % of ¾" Material [I/(L+I)×100] —
ONE-POINT PROCTOR SPECIMEN
N Weight of Specimen and Mold
O Weight of Mold
P Wet Weight of Specimen (N−O) —
Q Wet Density of Specimen (30×P) —
R Dry Density of Specimen [Q/(1+K/100)] —
K₂ Specimen Moisture % (measured from moisture tin) → R & LB-68 M/D Points
CURVE LOOKUPS & FINAL RESULTS

Select a Family of Curves above (or use Chart / Auto) to fill S, T, and U from the standard T-99 chart.

S Max Density (from curves) — pcf
T Optimum Moisture (from curves) — %
U Corrected Max Density (gravel correction) — pcf
V % Compaction (C/U×100) —
W % of Optimum Moisture (K/T×100) —
